page.layout: One column of running text, with italic side notes in the left margin and small quotation marks «, one per line, in the right margin. Running head and page number at the top. Last line "f III:" sits under the text at the right.

main_text.p: in filijs a.nuptiis & civili & naturali iure requiritur. Quin etiam, ut intelligatur quam multa sub paucis interdū verbis lateant, exemplum ex tutelæ definitione sumemus. Tutela, inquit Vlpianus, est« vis ac potestas in capite libero, ad tuendum eum, qui propter ætatem se defendere ne« quit.«
Tutela est potestas.) Enunciatio I: Tutela non modò procuratio est, sed etiam potestas: id est, vis à populo accepta.
In capite libero.) Sequitur II: Tutela, nisi in liberis personis, non datur.

page.notes: Printed text is in the page as read. Long s transcribed as plain s; u/v and i/j normalised. Page number read as "81" from a worn italic numeral and is doubtful. The "f" before "III:" is a line-start mark, possibly a signature or catchword fragment, and is uncertain. The small « marks in the right margin are typographic quotation markers, transcribed as margin notes.
